standard_prerequisites: Chapter definition-normal-closure (source definition): the normal closure of L over K is the minimal normal subextension containing L inside the ambient algebraic closure
Chapter lemma-separable-first (source lemma): inside a normal algebraic extension M over K sits the tower M over M_sep over K, where M_sep collects the elements separable over K
Chapter lemma-separable-first-normal (delivered card L48368): M_sep over K is normal
Chapter convention: Galois means normal and separable
core_obligations: L over K is separable, so every element of L is separable over K, giving L contained in M_sep
M_sep over K is normal by the separable-first-normal lemma and contains L, so the minimality of the normal closure forces M contained in M_sep; the reverse inclusion is definitional, hence M = M_sep
M = M_sep is separable over K by construction and normal by the separable-first-normal lemma, so M over K is Galois
proof_roadmap: Place L inside the separable-first subextension of M
Run the minimality of the normal closure and conclude Galois
